messages:
Noah Bright (StormLytics): Hi team, INV-9481 shows a Dedicated overage after our emergency failover on 2026-06-11. We expected reserved commit to cover. Can someone check?
Maya Patel: forwarding to billing ops. Can you paste the invoice line and any ticket IDs?
Noah Bright (StormLytics): Invoice line:
  LineItem: DEDICATED_BURST
  Period: 2026-06-11
  ReservedCommit: 900,000 token-hours
  BurstUsage: 1,450,000 token-hours
  Charge: $10,350
  Support ticket: SUP-66220
Priya Rao: opening BILL-2026-1048. Action: export per-node meters for 06-11 02:00-04:00 UTC and map to the invoice.
billing-bot: Alert: Dedicated burst threshold exceeded for account stormlytics-prod at 2026-06-11T02:18:40Z  estimate: $10,350
Eliot Chen: CS note: customer says this was an emergency DB failover triggered by our incident window, lasted ~55m. They notified support but didn't get pre-authorization.
Maya Patel: policy: reserved commits don't auto-waive burst charges on cross-region failover. We offer a one-time SLA goodwill credit for verified emergency failovers. Provisional credit suggestion: $3,500.
Priya Rao: will reconcile logs and check 30-day history for repeat events. If it's a single emergency and meters match, I'll approve the provisional credit and attach recon to the invoice. Recon ETA 48h.
Noah Bright (StormLytics): Thanks, appreciate the quick help — we'll share the postmortem once ready.
Maya Patel: noted. We'll also offer a Solutions review to tune standby sizing to reduce charge risk.
